items.quote:
the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.
24  As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him
items.contrast: The reader must resolve whether the traveler killed by the lion is the man of God or the prophet who brought him back.
items.reason: The prophet saddles the donkey for the man of God, after which the beneficiary continues on his way and is killed. Thus the pronouns in verse 24 refer to the man of God, not the prophet.
